title: Scoped SSO + Keying Hardening Playbook for Private Migration
creator: Maya Chen
description: This ticket defines a minimum viable security hardening scope for customers migrating from Redwood's hosted offering to Private (VPC/on-prem) deployments. The goal is to produce a prescriptive playbook and an implementable PRD that covers: SSO (SAML 2.0) onboarding flows, IdP group-to-role mappings for RBAC, auditable event surface and retention, and customer-managed keying with KMS/HSM integration. The deliverable is a sign-offable checklist (InfoSec, Platform Eng, Legal, Customer Success) and clear acceptance criteria that allow Dedicated/Private rollouts to proceed without open security gaps.
scope_changes: Initial scope included full OIDC + SAML + attribute-based access controls. After Platform & Eng triage (2026-03-03), we scoped to SAML 2.0 MVP + configurable attribute mapping and deferred full OIDC implementation to post-launch. HSM remote attestation and air-gap tooling are scoped as stretch but must have documented acceptance gates.
tradeoffs_and_decisions:
- Implement SAML 2.0 first (widest enterprise compatibility) rather than OIDC to reduce launch risk.
- Provide a flexible mapping UI for group->role mapping instead of building a full ABAC engine in phase 1.
- KMS integration will support provider-initiated CMEK + PKCS#11 for HSM; automatic key rotation tooling will be limited to scheduled rotation commands rather than fully automated rotation across all providers initially.
- Audit pipeline will ship with structured JSON events and syslog/HTTP exporters; long-term SIEM integrations (Splunk/QRadar connectors) are an integration backlog item.
acceptance_criteria: SSO-AC1: Import SAML 2.0 metadata (IdP) UI and CLI flow implemented; test harness validates SP and IdP exchanges with signed assertions.
SSO-AC2: Support SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows; automated testcases for both included in e2e smoke suite.
SSO-AC3: Certificate rotation flow supported with zero-downtime validation path and rollback instructions documented.
RBAC-AC1: Role model (admin/operator/viewer/custom) defined and enforced at API and console layer; role assignment via IdP group mapping is configurable per-tenant.
RBAC-AC2: Fine-grained access validation added to at least 20 critical endpoints (model-serving, rollout controls, key material access) and covered by unit tests.
KMS-AC1: Customer-managed keys (CMEK) supported for model key wrapping; integration tested with at least one cloud KMS (AWS KMS) and one PKCS#11 HSM emulator.
KMS-AC2: Key rotation documented and runnable via CLI; rotation must not invalidate existing encrypted assets during rollover window.
AUDIT-AC1: All auth events, key ops (create/rotate/delete/export), role changes, and deployment rollouts produce structured JSON audit events with consistent schema v1.
AUDIT-AC2: Audit export targets configurable (syslog over TLS, HTTPS push); retention policy and WORM guidance documented for 90/365 day options.
COMPLIANCE-AC1: InfoSec sign-off obtained confirming SOC2 baseline controls covered by this deliverable and no open high-severity gaps remain.
OPERATION-AC1: Playbook includes incident runbook for key compromise with steps for revocation, rotation, and customer communication templates.
PERF-AC1: Authentication and authorization path adds no more than 15ms median latency to request token validation on the serving hot path when using local cache enabled.
TEST-AC1: Acceptance tests added to pipeline and a customer staging tenant validated by Solutions Engineering (test report linked below).
DOCUMENTATION-AC1: Customer-facing onboarding guide, internal runbook, and a checklist for CSM handoff published.
SEC-AC1: Security review completed and recorded; any high/critical findings must be resolved before GA.
ROLLBACK-AC1: Clear rollback criteria and steps documented for SAML onboarding and CMEK enablement if customer-reported regressions exceed threshold.

release_notes_summary: Adds SAML 2.0-based SSO onboarding for Private deployments, tenant-scoped RBAC mapping from IdP groups, structured audit events and CMEK/HSM support (initial providers). Feature gated for gradual rollout.
risk_register:
- Risk: Incorrect group mappings causing privilege escalation. Mitigation: require manager approval for initial mappings and provide preview of effective permissions.
- Risk: Key rotation causing temporary unavailability. Mitigation: rotation window and roll-back; pre-flight validation.
- Risk: Missing audit exports to customer's SIEM. Mitigation: default to buffered HTTPS exporter and confirm endpoint reachability in onboarding checklist.
estimated_cost_impact: Implementation effort ~3-5 sprint-equivalents; infra cost for HSM testing and staging estimated at $8k for prototype month.
